title: Smooth real differential operators and coordinate principal symbols
statement: Over $\mathbf R$ [def-weil-field], let $N$ be a smooth $m$-manifold without boundary [def-sfb-smooth-real-manifold] and let $G,H$ be smooth finite-rank real vector bundles [def-sfb-smooth-real-vector-bundle]. Use their smooth-section spaces [def-sfb-smooth-bundle-sections]. For $d\in\mathbf N$, a real-linear map $Q:\Gamma^\infty(G)\to\Gamma^\infty(H)$ is a smooth differential operator of order at most $d$ if, near every point in smooth bundle frames and coordinates, it has the expression $Qs(y)=\sum_{|\alpha|\le d} b_\alpha(y)\partial^\alpha s(y)$ for smooth linear-map-valued coefficients $b_\alpha$. Here $\partial^\alpha$ is the iterated real coordinate derivative, in increasing coordinate order. Its degree-$d$ coordinate symbol at a real coordinate covector $\xi$ is $\sum_{|\alpha|=d} b_\alpha(y)\xi^\alpha$, with no factor of $i$; transport by the frame maps gives the corresponding map $G_x\to H_x$. Local presentations may use smaller open neighborhoods inside the coordinate and frame domains.
